title: Aqua Gold Resin Desk Organiser
description:
Handmade resin artwork with functional use.

Elegant aqua and gold colour combination
Perfect for pens, makeup brushes, paint brushes, or stationery.
Beautiful statement piece for desks, vanities, studios, and gifting.

Each piece is unique due to the handmade resin process

Best For:
Desk styling
Home office decor
Makeup brush holder
Artist brush holder
Gift for creatives
Luxury handmade home decor

Material:
High-quality resin, gold leaf detailing, resin crystal accents.

Care Instructions:
Wipe gently with a soft dry or slightly damp cloth. Avoid harsh chemicals, direct heat, and prolonged direct sunlight. 

Handle with care to maintain the shine and detailing.
